g.text: Lab PSU 3.3 V + ESP-Prog JTAG -> SOIC-8 clip -> 25xx SPI flash on the target PCB
target PCB: its own power sources removed

text.tspan: target PCB fully unpowered; clip pin 1 on the chip dot; clip on/off only with PSU output off and USB unplugged
power order: PSU on, check 3.3 V on VCC, then ESP-Prog USB in; reverse to disconnect

g.text: rest of the board: its rails and buses share these pins
